name: Singapore Life Ltd. (Singlife)

scam_info.sample: Scam messages are created from fake email accounts that closely resemble legitimate one but have subtle changes (e.g., cs_life@singlif1.com instead of cs_life@singlife.com).
scam_info.notes: Security Advisory: scammers posing as Singlife staff/FARs acting for MAS; fake email example cs_life@singlif1.com (fake domain singlif1.com, text only, never visited). Official: emails only from domain singlife.com; numbers registered with SMS Sender ID Registry (IDs not named); hotline 6827 9933. Date = sitemap lastmod. Related: /en/security-practices (not opened).

notes: official_domains: singlife.com (a: 'Emails from Singlife will only be sent under the official domain singlife.com'; b: serving domain). singlife.darwinbox.com (careers, third-party HR platform) seen in links - not added.
